story_sequence.text: `VERSION_GOVERNANCE_SURFACES.project_governance` remains the only truth surface (`version_governance_truth`, `is_truth=True`) for `docs/beacon/governance/project-version-governance.md`.
`resolve_truth_map` / entrypoint inventory documents governance truth vs sqlite projection roles for operators and skills.
`project_metadata_current` / events store `source_hash` from governance MD frontmatter; full `payload_json` is optional diagnostic cache, not a competing write authority.

`doctor metadata verify` (and governance verify helper) fails closed when MD `source_hash` ≠ sqlite `source_hash` or sqlite row missing while MD authoritative (`reason_code`: `governance_projection_drift`).
No commit path may load sqlite `payload_json` to mutate governance MD; commits flow MD → sqlite projection only.
`resolve_project_governance(version=…)` uses **active** contract for branch preflight; **archived** contracts are ignored unless `--include-archived` (doctor/inspect only).
`beacon doctor metadata archive-version --version <v>` sets contract `validation_state: archived` via the same MD transaction as upsert (no JSON sink).
`beacon doctor metadata prune-archived` removes archived `###` blocks from governance MD with `--dry-run` default; strict verify passes after prune.
